findings.title: Add-field focus preservation removed
findings.description: Code that preserved input focus/value/caret across re-renders is deleted. Mobile keyboard will now dismiss on any source entity update. Verify this was tested on mobile or is an acceptable trade-off.

findings.title: Retry timeout wrapper removed without explanation
findings.description: withTimeout (8s per-attempt) was defensive against network stalls; removing it makes retries depend on browser default (potentially 30+ seconds). Confirm whether this is deliberate simplification or accidental deletion.

findings.title: Focus toggle removed
findings.description: The 'Show all' button to undo a focus is gone; Focus now one-way. Verify this is intentional product change, not unintentional loss of functionality.
